entries.note: Booked and waiting for Consegnia's rider to collect it from the shipper: a new booking's first and only scan, at its booking clock. Histories copied from its former tracker list it among their other scans at the copy's one clock.
The tracker shows the reason beside the status; the adapter adds it after a colon.

entries.wording: Delivery Failed: COT - Courier Out of Time
entries.note: The courier ran out of time on the round.
